Plate / batch NPX distribution plot

Source: R/plot_bridge.R
plot_plate_qc.Rd

Summarizes sample-level or assay-level NPX distributions across plates or batches to diagnose batch shifts before or after bridging normalization. Draws a boxplot and jittered sample medians for each plate/batch, with a dashed global median reference line.

Usage

plot_plate_qc(
  data,
  plate_col = NULL,
  assay_col = NULL,
  value_col = NULL,
  sample_col = NULL,
  panel_col = NULL,
  palette = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame in long format or an OlinkExperiment.

plate_col

Name of the plate or batch column. If `NULL`, auto-detected from `PlateID`, `Plate`, `Batch`, `batch`, or `Project`.

assay_col, value_col, sample_col, panel_col

Optional column names. If `NULL`, auto-detected.

palette

Optional color palette for plates/batches.

title

Plot title.

...

Additional arguments passed to `ggplot2::geom_boxplot()`.

Value

A ggplot object. `p$data` has one row per `(sample, plate, panel)` with column `.median` holding the sample's median NPX.

Examples

# \donttest{
plot_plate_qc(probc)

# }
